summary.text: Kennedy Moore is the Democratic candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 73, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A political organizer, she holds degrees from the University of Missouri, Columbia and the University of Missouri, St. Louis.

paragraphs.text: Moore earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Missouri, Columbia in 2018 and a graduate degree from the University of Missouri, St. Louis in 2022.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she became a student organizer in 2015 at the University of Missouri and worked as a camp counselor with the Missouri Legislative Black Caucus during the summers of 2016 to 2018.
She said she moved to the St. Louis region in 2018, began a career in public relations, and became a Black Organizing Summer School fellow with Action St. Louis in 2020.
Moore described herself in the survey as a community organizer from Ferguson.
She said she supports funding public schools rather than private vouchers, protecting and expanding Medicaid, and abortion access as health care.
